validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED. Independent evidence the physical gas link exists: (1) Offshore-technology.com (GlobalData) on the Qatif/Abu Sa'fah program states Qatif field associated gas (~330 MMscfd, program designed for 370 MMscfd) 'is sent to the Berri Gas Plant', with the Berri plant expanded (low-pressure sweetening +250 MMcf/d to 871 MMcf/d, Nov 2005) specifically to take Qatif gas; (2) Wikipedia 'Qatif Project' independently states the same Qatif-gas-to-Berri routing and Aramco operatorship; (3) GulfPub PE World Map (Dec-2025 SDE scrape) independently carries 'Qatif - Berri Pipeline', status operating, operator Aramco. Three separate origins agree the pipe exists and carries Qatif gas to Berri. So this is NOT a phantom despite the weak gem.wiki citation.

CLASSIFICATION — CONFIRMED (gas). It transports Qatif field gas to the Berri Gas Plant for processing; it is a gas line, not oil/NGL/water. Caveat: it is functionally a field-to-plant associated-gas gathering/transmission feeder rather than a long-haul MGS trunk, but GEM logs the whole SA field-to-plant gas fleet (P1897-P1925) this way, so the classification is internally consistent.

DUPLICATE — none found. No other GEM row runs Qatif->Berri (checked full 40-row SA gas operating roster: the other Berri feeders are Abu Ali-Berri P1921/P7768, Tanajib-Berri P1904, Abqaiq-Berri P1906, UBTG-1-Berri P1898/P1899, Berri-Abu Ali P1922/P1923 — all different endpoints). GulfPub 'Qatif - Berri Pipeline' IS this same physical pipe (a corroborating match, not a GEM duplicate). GulfPub also lists 'Abqaiq - Qatif' separately, a different segment.

ATTRIBUTION — CONFIRMED. Owner Saudi Aramco 100% (offshore-technology, Wikipedia, GulfPub op=Aramco). FuelSource=Qatif correct (Qatif field associated gas). Region Eastern Province correct. End 'Berri Gas Plant' correct. Start should ideally name the Qatif field / Qatif North GOSP rather than the bare province.

SPEC — CONCERN. GEM: 45 km, 32 in. GulfPub (independent): 32 km, 29 in. Material disagreement on BOTH length and diameter, and NO independent public source confirms GEM's numbers (the OGJ 'Berri, Qatif pipeline work' 2007 article describes 12-30 in OIL and WATER-INJECTION lines, not this gas line, so it is not corroboration). Capacity blank; GulfPub Capacity_mmcfd=300 is the known constant placeholder, not a real value; associated-gas figures (~330 MMscfd from the field) describe throughput to the plant, not a verified pipeline design capacity, so Capacity left blank. Length/diameter flagged unresolved.

Line carries Qatif field associated gas to the Berri Gas Plant; both sources describe gas routing Qatif->Berri. Fuel=Gas confirmed.
Gas originates as associated gas from the Qatif field (~330 MMscfd designed). FuelSource=Qatif confirmed by 2 independent sources plus GulfPub endpoint.

End = Berri Gas Plant (Al Jubail area, Eastern Province) confirmed; start is the Qatif field in Eastern Province (StartLocation blank in sheet - recommend adding 'Qatif field'/'Qatif North GOSP'). GulfPub gives Qatif field -> Berri field, consistent.

Qatif program and Berri Gas Plant are wholly Saudi Aramco assets; GulfPub op=Aramco. Owner Saudi Aramco 100% confirmed. (This ref stages onto the ProjectID-keyed operators/owners tab, oo_sheet_row 1449.)

GEM's 45 km is unconfirmed by any independent public source; GulfPub gives 32 km. Straight-line Qatif field (~26.6N,50.0E) to Berri Gas Plant (~26.95N,49.59E) is ~55 km, so a routed 45 km is plausible but not corroborated. Left UNRESOLVED - do not add a ref propping up 45 km. Recommend low confidence + re-source.

GEM's 32 in is unconfirmed; GulfPub gives 29 in. No independent source states this gas line's diameter (the OGJ 2007 contract covers 12-30 in oil/water-injection lines, not this gas line). Left UNRESOLVED; recommend low confidence.

routes.start_name: Qatif field / Qatif North GOSP area, Eastern Province
routes.end_name: Berri Gas Plant, Al Jubail, Eastern Province
routes.corridor_desc: Onshore Eastern Province corridor running roughly NNW from the Qatif oil field (west of Qatif town) toward the Berri Gas Plant on the northern edge of Jubail Industrial City. Loosely bounded: start coordinate is a Qatif-field-area approximation (anchored on Qatif town ~26.56N,50.0E; individual GOSP positions are not public), end coordinate is the Berri Gas Plant (from public mapping, mapcarta/openinframap). Straight-line ~55 km; a real routed length near GEM's 45 km or GulfPub's 32 km is plausible depending on which Qatif GOSP is the true origin. No traced polyline available.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints (Qatif field -> Berri Gas Plant) established from 2 independent sources + GulfPub. End coordinate is the well-known Berri Gas Plant location (~26.954N,49.586E). Start coordinate is a defensible field-area approximation from named place (Qatif); exact GOSP origin not public - NOT fabricated to false precision. No waypoints sourced, so I suggest LOW accuracy rather than the current medium until a real corridor/route is traced.

summary: P1916 real + correctly classified (gas, Aramco, Qatif->Berri) confirmed by offshore-technology + Wikipedia + GulfPub; CONCERN=spec: length 45km & dia 32in unverified and conflict with GulfPub (32km/29in), and gem.wiki's only cite (OPEC ASB) doesn't name the line.
